author: @ramkrishs

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking change. This commit only modifies the text of an error message thrown by assert_http_ok in the CLI client. There is no API, config, CLI flag, or persisted format change. Existing scripts and users are unaffected except for a more accurate message in edge cases.
evidence.documentation: The PR body serves as adequate inline documentation with its error-code-to-message mapping table. No external docs or CLI help text need updating — the change is a bug fix to error messaging, not a new feature. The known limitation (read timeout and closed-connection sharing one message) is called out in the PR body.
evidence.manual_release_testing: Not required — the change only alters error message text for two specific network error conditions (Read/Write vs. everything else). There is no new behavior, flag, endpoint, or config. The existing test suite exercises both code paths. Users upgrading will simply see a more accurate error message when the server drops a connection mid-request (e.g., during a backend load/unload).
evidence.post_approval_commits: Two commits were added after the first approval (2026-10-26T15:18:18Z): (1) 253ef66d — drops the ConnectionTimeout branch and its explanatory comment so that only Read/Write errors get the new 'closed connection' message (this was @bitgamma's earlier nit about removing an unnecessary comment). (2) 4bc73b38 — a merge of main into the feature branch. The 253ef66d change narrows the behavior scope (removing the ConnectionTimeout-specific message) which is consistent with the PR's original intent and was covered by the subsequent approvals from @Geramy and @bitgamma. No commits were added after the latest approval at 2026-10-27T07:38:57Z.
evidence.review: Three substantive approvals from @fl0rianr (approved first at 2026-10-26T15:18:18Z, subject area: cli), @Geramy (approved at 2026-10-27T03:36:09Z, subject area: sockets/tcp/ip), and @bitgamma (approved at 2026-10-27T07:38:57Z, subject area: cli). @bitgamma initially requested a comment removal (2026-10-26T17:48:40Z), which was addressed before re-approval. @Geramy commented to hold for @bitgamma before merge (2026-10-27T03:36:29Z). @jeremyfowers was requested as reviewer but did not respond. All three approving reviewers have CLI or networking subject area expertise per docs/dev/contribute.md. The PR description is thorough: it states the problem, the change with a clear error-code-to-message mapping, the tests, and a candid 'Not covered' section acknowledging that read timeouts share the same message as closed connections during a backend change.
evidence.security: No security concern. The change only examines an httplib error enum to select an error message string. No credential handling, network calls, code execution, or permission changes.
evidence.tests: Adds CLIConnectionErrorMessageTests in test/server_cli2.py with two cases: (1) a socket listener that accepts connections and immediately closes them — verifies the 'closed the connection' message appears and 'Make sure the server is running' does not. (2) an unused port — verifies the original 'Make sure the server is running' hint is preserved. Against the old code the first test fails and the second passes; with the change both pass. The tests are registered in the existing test suite via loader.loadTestsFromTestCase. No evidence of existing tests being weakened or deleted.
